stem: Which statement best describes El-ahrairah’s relationship with the fox?

options.label: A
options.text: They are enemies because the fox wants to eat rabbits.

options.label: B
options.text: They are enemies because they both eat the same food.

options.label: C
options.text: They become friends because the fox leaves the warren.

options.label: D
options.text: They become friends because they help each other.
